title: Attack and siege at Holey Artisan
detail: Armed attackers entered the Holey Artisan Bakery in Gulshan, Dhaka, and people inside were held during an overnight siege. The Islamic State group claimed responsibility; Bangladeshi authorities attributed the attack to a domestic militant network.

title: Security operation ends the siege
detail: Bangladeshi security forces entered the restaurant and ended the siege. Public accounts differ in details of the operation and its toll; figures are omitted because the attached sources do not support a consistent count.
